decision.reason: Both evidence excerpts [ev-782bc47d120d] and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] show only "apiVersion: v1" from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml. The change text shows only one added description line, "Deprecated: Use ProxySecretRef instead. Will be removed in v1.". Nothing shown names the CRD group, the kind or the field path this description belongs to, so the deprecated subject cannot be identified and no applicability predicate can be written. What is missing is the surrounding CRD schema context, or a release note or upgrade-guide entry that names the deprecated field.
